name: Downtown 21 B 1BDR
headline: The Bold Signature 1BDR Studio @ Cairo's Downtown (21B)
summary: This bold and expressive studio is located at the heart of Downtown Cairo, 250 meters away from the iconic Tahrir Square. The studio is an 8 minute walk from the Egyptian Museum and is surrounded with all kinds of restaurants, gift shops and cafes. The studio apartment features a comfortable queen bed, a big bathroom with a Jacuzzi and a fully loaded kitchenette.

description.Space:
The studio apartment features a queen size comfortable bed, a bathroom with a Jacuzzi and a sofa bed. It also features a fully loaded kitchenette, cooking utensils and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 55 inch smart TV with AirPlay built-in for further personal entertainment. 

Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 

The styling of the apartment is tailored to give the guests an authentic experience of Cairo's Downtown.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction:
We are more than happy to answer all of your questions 24/7. Guests can text and call anytime they need help and our team will be there in about 30 mins to solve any issue immediately.

At Xuru Stays, we’re committed to providing our guests the magical hospitality they deserve.
description.Neighborhood:
Cairo's Downtown is a busy neighborhood packed with a lot of places to explore and enjoy:

- The Egyptian Museum is an 8 minute walk.
- Tahrir Square is a 3 minute walk.
- Cairo International Airport is a 35 minute drive.
- Giza Pyramids is a 35 minute drive
description.Transit: We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours.
description.Notes:
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry.

location_address1: 15 Al Bustan St, Bab Al Louq, Abdeen, Cairo Governorate 4280120
agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 


Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Wonderful place! Great location and very easy to manage Check in and Check out,

Amazing place!

Wonderful stay. The place is as shown with a lovely kitchenette and a luxurious jacuzzi. It was really a joy to stay. Although I was slightly taken aback by the lobby and lift but it just require some getting used to.

Some points to note or possibly improve on for otherwise this stay would be perfect.

1) Floor could be mopped clean without the sandy feeling and peeling tiles.
2) Change of basin/tap because it is extremely user unfriendly.
3) Leaking tub
4) Water heater keeps going off and the H/C sign on tap is wrongly annotated making it very confusing.

But these are just minor issues that does not break the staying experience. So overall, I rate it 4stars.
جميل جدا

The place is as shown in pictures, nice space, nice bathroom. I gave them 4 stars because bedsheets were not clean and the response was not as fast as for rating it with 5 stars. 
The other thing guys, if you want 5 stars you need to win them, not asking for them. I don't think that's the point of reviews. I know you can do better and next time you'll double check that everything is clean and ready.
If I'd stay there again, yes, the place is worth it if you want to stay in Cairo downtown.

I initially gave this place 4 stars with a fair review, even saying that I'd stay there again, but I changed my mind later on after their review on my profile because I didn't give them 5 stars review requested persistently by them. 
I arrived late at night at the apartment and I left a message that the bedsheets were dirt and even with red stains (I have pictures). I had to text again these guys in the morning at 10 am as I didn't get any reply. I asked them for an ETA for coming to change the bedsheets and they say 30 minutes. I went out for breakfast and I came an hour later, so I notified them and even after that time they took 30 minutes more. Funny story is from their WhatsApp number they replied at 1:30 pm, that was my sarcastic answer as that number was supposed to be an easier and faster way to reach out to them. Long story short I miss the whole morning there. The worst part of the story is their persistence to rate them with 5 stars as if I rated them less than that it would affect their business and if I did so, they will rate me with 5 stars. I gave them 4 stars saying that I'd stay again there. Well it turns out that I changed my mind now. I have all the messages from the WhatsApp number they provide with all their persistent requests of getting 5 stars rating, that of course they will not use messaging through Airbnb. The only thing I never replied was their intent of them to buy my review with some sort of compensation, which I was never looking for. Another thing to consider is the additional services they offer, after seeing their offer of a taxi ride for 25 USD whilst you can get an Uber ride at the airport for 5 USD, made me not even consider their tours. Closing remark is these guys focus more on plaguing gest to rate than well rather than providing a real good experience, and I can prove all this with pictures and their communications on WhatsApp.

I really don’t like leaving negative reviews but just want to be honest. I’ll start off by saying the place was beautiful, clean, and very well designed. The location is great- in the center of everything so you could either walk or take a cheap Uber anywhere. Our biggest issue was the workers in the building constantly haggling us. I truly hated it and it gave me anxiety anytime I had to come or go. As soon as they would hear us open our door, they would rush to try to talk to us even though they didn’t speak English and we didn’t speak Arabic but that didn’t stop them from still trying to talk nonstop. I’m sure they didn’t mean any harm and we ended up being safe our entire stay there but it was truly uncomfortable. If I come back to Egypt I’d rather pay more and stay in a hotel. I wasn’t used to the haggling pestering culture in this area, so if that doesn’t bother you, then your ok be fine. The hosts were kind & responsive and let us check out late hence why we still gave 4/5.

Долго выбирали жилье в центре Каира и в итоге сняли студию как оптимальное соотношение цена/качества. Нас было трое: мы с мужем и сын 9 лет. У студии отличная локация - очень рядом с площадью Тахрир (удобно говорить таксистам) и метро, легко добираться куда угодно. В студии было чистое белье и полотенца, приличная мебель. При заселении была застелена только кровать - я написала попросила принести белье для софы (на ней большой матрас, можно спать и взрослому) - через 15 минут все принесли. Студия не большая, но мы в ней только ночевали. Находится в старинном доме - мы приехали ночью, привратник нас пустил, далее мы своим ключом открывали уличную дверь (если после полуночи возвращались). Легко нашли жилье и самостоятельно заселились по видео-инструкции. Из минусов могу выделить немного плесени на потолке и стене в ванной - типовая особенность старых домов. В самой студии никаких неприятных запахов не было. Так же особо негде сушить полотенца - я вешала на этажерку для одежды. Жили 4 дня

Das Apartment war sehr funktional, gemütlich und hervorragend eingerichtet. Alles war extrem sauber und die Lage ist unschlagbar zentral – die meisten Sehenswürdigkeiten lassen sich bequem zu Fuß erreichen, und man kommt überall problemlos hin. Vor dem Haus gibt es sogar einen sehr hilfsbereiten Portier, der proaktiv Taxis organisiert und bei allem unterstützt. Besonders positiv war der organisierte Shuttle-Service vom Flughafen, der mich direkt kontaktiert hat – das hat mir die Ankunft enorm erleichtert. Da ich alleine gereist bin, war der Service perfekt: Es wurden mir direkt Ausflüge angeboten und alles für mich geplant. Absolut empfehlenswert, vor allem für alle, die zum ersten Mal in Kairo sind. Vielen Dank! 🤩💖

L’appartement est situé en plein quartier downtown avec de nombreux commerces à proximité. 
Le logement était propre et l’hôte très rapide pour les communications. Ils nous ont même proposé ce logement car celui que nous avions réservé de base était en travaux, nous surclassant gratuitement. 

Cependant, faites attention aux personnes qui sont à l’entrée de l’immeuble, certaines ne sont pas employées de l’airbnb, et l’une d’elle a été irrespectueuse envers ma femme. Cette personne connaissait le conducteur de taxi et a insisté pour nous accompagner jusqu’à l’appartement. Soyez vigilants et n’hésitez pas à être ferme (conseil valable pour tout votre séjour en Égypte).
I enjoyed staying at the Xuru Stays, it’s my second time booking with them. The experience was smooth, and I can recommended them to other travelers.
